title: Question 19
passage:
Is the boat coming in now the last one?
A. No, there is another one after this. B. The dock has two ramps. C. The tickets are in my pocket.
passageZh:

A. 不是，這艘之後還有一班。 B. 碼頭有兩條斜坡。 C. 船票在我的口袋裡。
